card.name: Using the whole amount of liquid
card.fires_on: The word right after an action verb like push, inject, withdraw, use or add, where the next words refer to the whole or remaining amount (all, all of, the remainder). Seen in device and preparation instructions.

modes.label: All after a handling verb
modes.description: The word "all" follows a verb such as inject, withdraw, administer or use, before the liquid or contents.
modes.example: Uncap the oral syringe and administer<< all>> the suspension into the patient's mouth.

modes.label: Making sure of full delivery
modes.description: Words that lead into completing the full dose, such as "make sure" or "add the remainder".
